name: Virtual Texture Memory for Magnification Lenses
definition: A scheme to keep bricks in a single memory pool and use an index volume to locate them, allowing arbitrary coordinate transformations (like magnification) in the fragment shader without rebinding textures.
summary: Virtual Texture Memory for Magnification Lenses enables interactive zooming of large volume datasets by dynamically mapping virtual coordinates to a single GPU texture pool via an index volume, avoiding texture rebinding.
